name: Stage lights
description: An empty stage at a sound check, seen from the floor of the hall: eight moving lights on a truss, each a part of the spectrum, swing their beams through the haze, widening and brightening with their parts and throwing pools on the boards; a fan of lasers tilts over the hall with the high notes; a wall of LEDs behind shows the spectrum as bars, mirrored in the glossy deck; the speaker cones pump with the bass.
